map.由衰变常数与时间求存活概率: Find the survival probability from the decay constant and time
map.输入衰变常数 λ 与时间 t，求核素存活概率。: Enter the decay constant λ and the time t to get the survival probability of the nuclide.
map.📖 查看「由衰变常数与时间求存活概率 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the survival probability from the decay constant and time"
map.P = e^(−λt) 求经时间 t 仍未衰变的概率。: P = e^(-λt) gives the probability of still being undecayed after time t.
map.对比不同 λt 的存活率。: comparisons of the survival rate for different λt.
map.P = e^(−1) ≈ 0.3679，即约 36.8% 存活、63.2% 已衰: P = e^(-1) ≈ 0.3679, i.e. about 36.8% survive while 63.2% have decayed.
map.若 t=ln2/λ，则 P=0.5，恰好一半存活。: if t = ln2/λ, then P = 0.5, so exactly half survive.

map.互补：衰变份额 = 1 − P，见 decay-fraction。: Complementary: the decayed fraction = 1 - P, see decay-fraction.
map.对单个核有意义吗？: Does it mean anything for a single nucleus?
map.指数律是统计规律，对大量核给出比例，对单核为衰变概率。: The exponential law is statistical: it gives a proportion across many nuclei and a decay probability for any single one.
map.放射性存活概率（本页代码口径）：P=e^(−λt)（λ 衰变常数、t 时间，两者: Radioactive survival probability (this page's code basis): P = e^(−λt) (λ decay constant, t time, the two being reciprocal in dimension); linked values: decay probability = 1−P, half-life = ln2÷max(λ,10⁻³⁰), survival percentage = P×100 (%). Validation: no strict validation; empty values fall back to 0 (denominator guarded against division by zero). Criteria: no fixed grading; survival probability halves with each half-life, and λt is the negative number of half-lives elapsed.
